hardware_thresholds.threshold_role: operational acceptance gates, not physics claims

physics_interpretation: Each hardware target is the corresponding two-step Trotter result, not the exact continuous-time value. Exact-state fidelity is reported descriptively and is not used as a freeze gate.
review_note: Six reduced matter-readout circuits for a two-step Sirius scan. The circuits do not directly measure Wilson or Gauss operators; sector certification remains a separate diagnostic layer.
